rules.label: Page & asset cache
rules.note: Temporary web files the browser rebuilds as you browse. Pages may load a little slower the first time afterwards.

rules.label: Cookies & site data
rules.note: Signs you out of websites and resets site preferences. Removed files go to quarantine, so you can restore them.

rules.label: Browsing trail
rules.note: Clears the visited-pages list and top-site thumbnails. Bookmarks are not touched. Restorable from quarantine.

rules.label: Last-session tabs
rules.note: Forgets the tabs from your last session, so 'restore previous tabs' will have nothing to bring back.

rules.label: Autofill profiles
rules.note: Removes saved autofill entries (names, addresses, cards saved in the browser). Restorable from quarantine.

rules.label: Stored sign-ins
rules.note: Removes passwords saved in this browser, so you must sign in again. Restorable from quarantine. Passwords synced to an account can return on the next sync.

rules.label: Legacy web cache
rules.note: Cache used by Internet Explorer mode and embedded web views. Rebuilt on demand.

rules.label: Legacy cookies
rules.note: Signs you out of websites and resets site preferences. Removed files go to quarantine, so you can restore them.

rules.label: Legacy visit list
rules.note: Clears the visited-pages list and top-site thumbnails. Bookmarks are not touched. Restorable from quarantine.

rules.label: Recently opened shortcuts
rules.note: The shortcuts behind Recent files lists. Your documents themselves are not touched.

rules.label: Taskbar jump lists
rules.note: Recent and pinned items shown when you right-click a taskbar icon. Pinned items are forgotten too.

rules.label: Thumbnail & icon cache
rules.note: Picture previews and icons Explorer rebuilds when needed.

rules.label: Recycle Bin
rules.note: Empties the Recycle Bin on every drive. Its files cannot be restored afterwards.

rules.label: Personal temp files
rules.note: Leftovers programs create in your temp folder. Files from the last day are left alone.

rules.label: System temp files
rules.note: Files you cannot delete without administrator rights are skipped, never forced.

rules.label: Clipboard contents
rules.note: Clears whatever you last copied. Handy after copying a password.

rules.label: Name-lookup cache
rules.note: Flushes the DNS resolver cache. Needs administrator rights on some PCs.

rules.label: Application crash dumps
rules.note: Diagnostic snapshots Windows saved when apps crashed.

rules.label: System memory dumps
rules.note: Large blue-screen snapshots. Keep them if you are chasing a crash.

rules.label: Error report archive
rules.note: Queued and archived Windows Error Reporting data.

rules.label: Servicing logs
rules.note: Old Windows servicing logs.

rules.label: Disk-check fragments
rules.note: File fragments chkdsk recovered (FILE0000.CHK). Check them before deleting if you lost data.

rules.label: Microsoft Store cache
rules.note: Downloaded store listings and images.

rules.label: Graphics shader caches
rules.note: Compiled GPU shaders. Games rebuild them, which can cause brief stutter on the next launch.

rules.label: Font cache
rules.note: Windows rebuilds the font cache at next start.

rules.label: Update download cache
rules.note: Windows re-downloads updates if needed. Do not clean while an update is pending.

rules.label: Delivery Optimization cache
rules.note: Update pieces kept to share with other PCs. Rebuilt on demand.

rules.label: Launch-speed hints
rules.note: Windows rebuilds these; the first launch of each app may be slightly slower.
